CLAV.includes: Available funds after all pending transactions
CLAV.note: Most commonly used for end-of-day available balance

CLBD.includes: All booked transactions, may include holds
CLBD.note: Official accounting balance, may differ from available

FWAV.descriptionLong: Balance that is at the disposal of account holders on the date specified
FWAV.note: Used for future projections or scheduled transactions

INFO.note: Informational only, not for financial decisions

ITAV.descriptionLong: Available balance calculated in the course of the day
ITAV.note: Best for real-time balance checks during business hours

ITBD.descriptionLong: Booked balance calculated in the course of the day
ITBD.note: Real-time booked balance, updated throughout day

OPAV.descriptionLong: Opening balance that is at the disposal of account holders at the beginning of the date specified
OPAV.note: Starting available balance, before any daily activity

OPBD.descriptionLong: Book balance of the account at the beginning of the account reporting period. It always equals the closing book balance from the previous report
OPBD.note: Opening balance matches previous period's closing balance

PRCD.descriptionLong: Balance of the account at the end of the previous reporting period
PRCD.note: Historical reference balance from previous period

VALU.note: Balance calculated based on value dates, not booking dates

XPCD.note: Real-time instant snapshot, most current available

metadata.source: Roaring.io - Global Bank Account Information API 1.0
metadata.priorityNote: Priority 1 = Most reliable for real-time decisions, 10 = Informational only
